retrieval.source_policy: First-party sources for technical claims. Product details generally remain single-source-family descriptions, not independently verified runtime behavior. Research findings are bounded by each study's methods.
retrieval.recording: Retained selected source identity, dates, bounded observations, conflicts and hashes of this repository at the stated baseline. Did not mirror full copyrighted pages or retain private account state.

retrieval.method: Web search and direct public technical sources as recorded on 2026-09-06.
retrieval.coverage_limit: This was a selected-source review. No exhaustive search or equivalence to an unavailable provider-specific retrieval mode was established.

critical_method: Test each supplied diagnosis against both supporting and contrary repository evidence.
Separate declaration, structural enforcement, delivery of context, behavior and user outcome.
Inspect recent changes that alter context, authority, side effects or completion semantics.
Do not infer the user's preferences from an assistant interpretation without an accessible supporting decision.
Propose an intervention at the earliest evidenced point of failure; avoid adding a generalized subsystem without need.

discipline_arms: shorter entry with equivalent applicable constraints
comparison_design.runtime_factor: Old and new harness versions only where reproducibly available; otherwise record the inability to roll back hosted behavior.
hold_fixed: initial memory and compaction state where relevant
comparison_design.blocking_unit: Repeat each task/configuration pair; interleave conditions; distinguish between-task from within-task variation.
memory_conditions: representative accumulated state where reproducibly available
comparison_design.reporting: Publish per-case observations and failures, not only a composite score. Do not claim equivalence from a non-significant difference. Choose thresholds and repetitions for the actual decisions and risk.
limits: Unknown server-side model/system-prompt rollouts can prevent clean causal attribution.
Hidden tests do not exhaust product requirements.
Fresh-context reviewers may share model and specification errors.
Finite observations do not prove an unbounded absence of side effects.

proposal_acceptance: A bounded runnable pilot with an original-goal-to-observed-result record; no repeated user sign-off at internal steps once authorized. New material facts may create a new bounded decision.
